title.en: An Act Declaring March 10 of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Holiday in Observance of the Araw Ng Siocon in the Municipality of Siocon, Province of Zamboanga Del Norte
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 10 of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Holiday in Observance of the Araw Ng Siocon in the Municipality of Siocon, Province of Zamboanga Del Norte
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 10 tháng 3 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Siocon, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Norte
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 10 มีนาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในเทศบาล Siocon จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Norte
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 10 Maret setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Kotamadya Siocon, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Norte
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 10 Mac setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Perbandaran Siocon, Wilayah Zamboanga Del Norte

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8434_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: March 10 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Municipality of Siocon, Province of Zamboanga del Norte, to celebrate the Araw ng Siocon commemorating its founding anniversary.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
